description: This file defines the AWSBedrock_LLMs class, a component for integrating AWS Bedrock large language models into a larger system. It includes imports, class properties, constructor initialization, method loadings for models and regions, and an async init method to instantiate the Bedrock model with credentials and parameters.

classes.name: AWSBedrock_LLMs
classes.description: A class implementing INode that wraps AWS Bedrock large language models, providing configuration, credential handling, and model initialization.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains asynchronous methods to list available models and regions for AWS Bedrock.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes an AWS Bedrock model instance with parameters and credentials based on node data.
